worker_evidence: Configured count plus actual maximum distinct phase claimants; no claim of simultaneous CPU utilization or graphical pacing.
fault_evidence: Explicit bounded helper overrides corrupt copied readback or skip a later erase while the real native World records actual earlier effects. This proves host refusal/fault discrimination and quarantine, not naturally occurring native corruption.
platform_limits: Linux/Windows claims require actual source-qualified runs. Headless synthetic input is not physical-device or graphical qualification; those rows remain separate.
